headline: GOLD CRASHES BELOW $4,370, SILVER PLUNGES 9% AS BLOWOUT JOBS REPORT FUELS RATE HIKE BETS
snippet: The US added 172,000 jobs in May — double the 85,000 consensus — sending gold down 3.2% to $4,331/oz and silver crashing 8.9% to $67.30/oz on Friday. Weekly gold losses hit nearly 4%, silver over 7%. Markets now price a quarter-point Fed rate hike by year-end, pushing precious metals to their lowest 2026 levels.

headline: MONEY METALS: THE GOLD AND SILVER MARKET JUST GOT SPOOKED — HERE IS WHY
snippet: Money Metals Exchange published a same-day analysis on June 6 examining Friday's brutal precious metals selloff. The piece digs into how a hot May payrolls number ignited dollar-strength and rate-hike expectations that wiped out weeks of gold and silver gains in a single session — and what retail stackers should make of it.

headline: WHY GOLD IS ACTING MORE LIKE A RISK ASSET THAN A SAFE HAVEN
snippet: Friday's 3.2% gold crash on a strong jobs report underscores a structural shift: gold increasingly sells off when the dollar rallies and rate-hike bets rise — just like equities. While central banks keep accumulating gold as a reserve asset, Western retail and hedge-fund traders are treating it like a risk trade, amplifying volatility in both directions.

headline: COPPER DROPS 4% TO $6.25/LB ON RATE FEAR; US TARIFF BOMB DECISION DUE JUNE 30
snippet: Copper futures fell to $6.25/lb on June 5, down 3.97% on the session, as the May jobs blowout stoked fears of higher-for-longer rates. Chile reported its weakest April copper output in 23 years. The US Commerce Dept must deliver a tariff recommendation by June 30 that could impose 15% duties on refined copper from 2027, rising to 30% from 2028.

headline: BARRICK EYES $30B AFRICA SPIN-OFF IN POTENTIAL ALL-SHARE MERGER WITH ENDEAVOUR MINING
snippet: Barrick Mining is exploring spinning off its African gold and copper operations into a new London-listed entity via an all-share merger with Endeavour Mining — a combined vehicle potentially worth US$30B. Discussions remain exploratory but would mark a permanent Africa exit following Barrick's costly standoff with Mali's military government over the Loulo-Gounkoto complex.

headline: MINING M&A ENTERS NEW PHASE: INVESTORS DEMAND GROWTH, EXECUTION AND ACCOUNTABILITY
snippet: Higher metals prices are giving mining companies more capital and strategic options, but investors are becoming less tolerant of complicated portfolios and missed guidance. Elliott Investment Management's A$1B-plus stake in Northern Star — and its public criticism of the miner's operational track record — signals that activist capital is now a structural force shaping mining M&A.

headline: GOLDSEEK COT REPORT: CROWDED GOLD AND SILVER LONGS WERE FULLY SET UP FOR FRIDAY'S ROUT
snippet: The weekly Commitment of Traders report as of June 2 showed speculative long positioning in gold and silver still elevated — exactly the fuel that made Friday's 172,000-job payrolls print so destructive. The report also notes silver has entered its sixth consecutive year of structural supply deficit, with industrial demand from solar, EVs and electronics outpacing flat mine supply.

headline: GUARDIAN METAL DISCOVERS THE "TREMOR ZONE" AT NEVADA TUNGSTEN PROJECT; 400M STRIKE LENGTH OPEN
snippet: Guardian Metal Resources (GMTL) discovered a new tungsten-skarn zone during Pre-Feasibility Study condemnation drilling at Pilot Mountain, Nevada. The opening hole returned 13.68m at 0.31% WO3; follow-up holes delineated 400m of strike length, open in all directions. Two diamond rigs are now testing extensions as the PFS continues.

headline: DELTA RESOURCES LAUNCHES LARGEST-EVER FIELD PROGRAM AT ONTARIO GOLD PROJECT
snippet: Delta Resources (TSX-V:DLTA) commenced its largest field exploration program to date at the Delta-1 Gold Project in Ontario's Thunder Bay District, initially targeting the I-Zone/Crayfish Creek Fault sector 18km southwest of the Eureka Deposit. Fully funded after closing a $6.56M flow-through financing in May.

headline: DPM METALS DRILLS 713 METRES AT 2.52 G/T GOLD EQUIVALENT IN MONSTER PORPHYRY FIND AT CHELOPECH
snippet: DPM Metals (TSX:DPM) hit 713m grading 2.52 g/t AuEq — comprising 1.31 g/t Au and 1.16% Cu — in a new porphyry target immediately adjacent to its operating Chelopech mine in Bulgaria, with the hole still in progress. Five drill rigs are on site and 15,000m of additional drilling is planned. DPM's fourth major discovery since 2023.

headline: EXCALIBUR METALS INTERSECTS 360 G/T SILVER AND 2 G/T GOLD IN NEVADA; 100-METRE ZONE OPEN AT DEPTH
snippet: Excalibur Metals intersected 360 g/t silver and 2.03 g/t gold over 1.52m at Bellehelen in Nye County, Nevada, within a broader envelope of 16.7 g/t Ag over 100.58m. The system is confirmed open to at least 300m depth. Partner Silver Range Resources (TSX-V:SNG) holds a carried interest and the zone remains a maiden drill program.
